name: Natsuki Yuuto
source:
The son of Kazuto and Miyuri who appeared during one of the epilogues of Ai's route. Kazuto is worried that he looks more like Akito than him.

Unknown to Kazuto, Yuuto is actually a child born from Miyuri and Akito's affair.
